Characters: @bau is Grandpa Bau, the purple ankylosaurus with round glasses and white eyebrows; @chiqui is Chiqui, the orange baby triceratops with a yellow-spotted frill; @roro is Roro, the yellow baby T-rex with orange spots on the back (round head, no frill, no horns); @torong is Torong, the green baby brachiosaurus with light-green spots; @pio is Pio, the little sky-blue pteranodon with a yellow beak. Draw them exactly like their element images. INDOORS inside Grandpa Bau's cozy round check-up room in the cave house (soft cream walls, a round window, a tall wooden height chart painted on the wall, a low wooden bench); NOT outdoors: no meadow, no open sky, no rainbow, no volcano. No toy dinosaurs, dolls, stuffed animals or animal figures anywhere. All five friends jump happily together facing the viewer, smiling big. SIZE RULE: Torong is MUCH TALLER than everyone else, with a very long neck, and Torong's head is high above all the other friends' heads; Pio is the smallest. Torong never touches the face with front legs. Draw exactly one of each character, never duplicated (5 characters in total). Show every character's full body from head to feet, with empty space around them; nothing is cut off at the edges. Keep the characters in the middle of the frame. Match the art style, colors, textures and lighting of @village (style only, do not copy its layout). Soft 3D toy-like clay style, smooth rounded shapes, soft studio lighting, gentle pastel color palette, very simple and readable for toddlers, no text.
vid: Everyone jumps once together and waves at the viewer. ONLY these 5 characters are in this scene: Grandpa Bau, Chiqui, Roro, Torong, Pio; no other character, animal or creature appears at any time. Torong stays much taller than everyone with a long neck the whole time. Pio always keeps wide thin sky-blue pteranodon wings, a pointed crest on the head and a long yellow beak; Pio never turns into a round bird or a chick. Roro always keeps a round head with no frill and no horns. The camera stays still: no zoom and no camera move; every character stays fully inside the frame from start to end. Do NOT add any baby, child, twin, copy, parent, or smaller or bigger version of any character. One continuous shot with no cuts and no scene changes. Keep every character exactly as in the start image and keep the soft 3D clay style unchanged. No new characters appear. Gentle, smooth motion.
